fields.name: PlayerHasFades
fields.evidence: Destructor bg3.exe+0x682800: frees values +0x70 and key set +0x40, then values +0x30 and key set +0 (two hash maps with trivial values). Toolkit EoCClient.dll+0x7DA130 (from ScreenFadeSyncingSystem::Update, EoCClient.dll+0x7D9CA0) gets a byte value by each short player id of ScreenFadeComponent (FUN_1807d9420), sets it to 1 when one of the player's fades in state 1-2 is not yet sync state 3, else 0; clears all to 0 when ScreenFadeComponent is empty. Live: 1-2 keys.

fields.name: FadeSyncStates
fields.evidence: EoCClient.dll+0x7DA370 emplaces by fade Guid under 'ls::HashMap<ls::Guid, enum eoc::screen_fade::EScreenFadeSyncState>::EmplaceUniversal' with 1-byte values (IndexedStorage<EScreenFadeSyncState>); Update advances the values 0->1->2->3 as UI frame ids change. EScreenFadeSyncState is 1 byte, not declared in SE.

fields.name: field_80
fields.evidence: ScreenFadeSyncingSystem::Update copies UIFrameIdSingletonComponent dword +4 here (old value compared to decide state 1->2). Live: small counter values.

fields.name: field_84
fields.evidence: Update copies UIFrameIdSingletonComponent dword +0 here (old value compared to decide state 2->3).

fields.name: Changed
fields.evidence: EoCClient.dll+0x7DA130 sets +0x88 to 0, then ORs in 1 whenever a PlayerHasFades value changes.
